metadata.documentation: The relay's config service when it is HoBo's config-service Worker (ADR-0179 amendment, Worker addendum). Consumers: the relay's loader (reads its folder with its Vercel OIDC token), HoBo's provisioning (health, the single-use seed) and the deploy workflow (writes the relay's folder with GitHub Actions OIDC); all three use createConfigServiceClient. Header values in braces are placeholders the provider verification replaces with tokens signed by local issuers; no interaction carries a real token or secret. Verified by contracts/provider/config-service-worker.provider.test.ts against the real handler and Durable Object class on the in-process stand-in.
